data.one_liner: Shows in‑app review prompts after customizable conditions on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter plugin that triggers the native in‑app review flow only when developer‑defined criteria are met (e.g., days after install, launch count). It wraps Android Play In‑App Review and iOS SKStoreReviewController APIs.
use_when: You want to request user reviews without leaving the app
You need to control when the review prompt appears based on usage metrics
avoid_when: You need a custom review UI or offline review collection
You target platforms other than iOS/Android
weaknesses: Only works on iOS and Android
Review dialog may not appear due to platform limits
data.setup_notes: Add Play In‑App Review dependencies in Android build.gradle as described in README; no extra iOS steps required beyond plugin installation.

alternatives.name: in_app_review
alternatives.why_pick_it: Direct wrapper of native review APIs without additional condition logic, simpler if you don't need custom timing
